title: chicken boss
description: Adds a powerful God Chicken boss that attacks players by spawning creepers and iron golems.
body:
**Chicken Boss Mod** adds a powerful evolving boss to Minecraft that starts as a normal chicken and gradually transforms into stronger forms.

The boss upgrades automatically every 4 minutes or when the previous stage is defeated, making the fight progressively harder.

**🔥 Boss Evolution Stages**

The Chicken Boss evolves through five dangerous stages:

1️⃣ Normal Chicken
The boss starts as a normal chicken, but it already targets the player.

2️⃣ Giant Chicken
The chicken grows into a massive version with higher health and stronger attacks.

3️⃣ Fire Chicken
This stage gains fire abilities and becomes much more dangerous.

4️⃣ Ender Chicken
The boss gains ender powers and becomes faster and harder to defeat.

5️⃣ God Chicken
The final stage of the boss with powerful abilities and chaotic attacks.

**⚡ Upgrade System**

The boss evolves in two ways:

⏱ Time Upgrade – Evolves automatically every 4 minutes.

☠ Kill Upgrade – Defeating a stage immediately triggers the next evolution.

This creates a progressively intense boss fight.

**💥 Special Abilities**

Depending on the stage, the boss can:

Spawn creepers near the player

Summon iron golems to attack

Target players directly

Become stronger with each evolution
